Solve a V2G window priced on its grid flows

Source: R/v2g.R
solve_grid_flows_v2g.Rd

Builds the problem of demand_cost_v2g_window() and demand_combined_v2g_window() on the bounds of get_bounds_v2g(). The unknown is X = [O, I, E], or [O, I, E, D] with the net discharge D: the optimized load keeps the box, departure and energy rows of the grid objective, and the site balance O - I + E = G - LS ties it to the import and the export. Their upper bounds follow from the box of O (which already carries the grid capacities, also negative ones), so the original-profile fallbacks of solve_optimization_window_v2g() stay feasible by construction: I and E are the profile's own net flows and D = max(-O, 0). Solved as in demand_solve_window(): a MILP with a binary grid mode (no import and export in the same slot) when the objective is linear, otherwise a QP with the export price clipped to the import price.

Usage

solve_grid_flows_v2g(bounds, G, LS, P, q, energy_floor, energy_ceiling)

Arguments

bounds

list, output of get_bounds_v2g().

G, LS

numeric vectors, production and static load.

P

numeric matrix or NULL, normalised quadratic term.

q

numeric vector, linear term.

energy_floor, energy_ceiling

numeric, energy range of the window.

Value

list with result (its status_message) and x
